title: fix: accept 1/yes/on for image and video boolean params
author: Connectslide121

gist.summary: Fixed boolean query parameters on `/image/{prompt}` and `/video/{prompt}` so values such as `audio=1` and `transparent=yes` enable their options instead of being read as false. Image and video parameters now use the text route’s `parseBooleanLike()` helper: `1`, `yes`, `on`, and `TRUE` resolve to true, while `0`, `no`, `off`, and unrecognized values resolve to false. Omitted `audio` remains unset, preserving per-model defaults. Legacy `safe` uses the helper, but its accepted values are unchanged because `SafeSchema` still rejects `1` and `yes`.
